meta.cardEncoding: rank char + suit char, e.g. 'As'=Ace of spades, 'Td'=Ten of diamonds, '2c'=Two of clubs. Ranks: 2-9,T,J,Q,K,A. Suits: h,d,c,s.

fields.hands: cards[], category (0-9), categoryName, kickers[] (engine tiebreakers descending), name (human), optional note
fields.compare: pair of 5-card hands a,b → result -1 (a<b), 0 (tie), 1 (a>b) via compareHands; ports need not match kickers numeric encoding if compare agrees
